title: Implement threaded discussion branches and recent tabs
verify: Replies support arbitrary depth and a root becomes a branch tab after its first reply.
At most ten recent active tabs are shown; hidden branch messages are retained and reappear after new activity.
evidence_required: FT-004-AC-003 RED: reply depth is capped, first reply does not create a branch tab, or common feed omits an available message; GREEN: arbitrary-depth replies persist, first reply creates the branch tab, and scoped common feed shows every available message; artifact: .tasks/TASK-012-T2-FT-004-W6/ and .protocols/TASK-012-T2-FT-004-W6/verification.md.

FT-004-AC-004 RED: more than ten active tabs are shown, hidden branch messages are deleted, or reactivation does not restore the branch; GREEN: ten most recent tabs are shown, hidden messages remain retained, and new activity restores the branch; artifact: .tasks/TASK-012-T2-FT-004-W6/ and .protocols/TASK-012-T2-FT-004-W6/verification.md.
purpose: Complete durable Collaboration discussion navigation without deleting or flattening message branches.
success_outcome: Arbitrarily nested replies remain available, common-day projection is scoped, and recent branch tabs are bounded to ten without message loss.
anti_goals: Do not delete or permanently hide inactive branches.
constraints: Branch tab visibility is a projection over retained Collaboration data.
Current user scope remains decisive for common-day projection.
invariants: Only ten most recently active branch tabs are visible at once.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-003: nested reply depth, first-reply branch-tab transition, and scoped common-feed completeness.
FT-004-AC-004: eleven-plus branch ordering, ten-tab bound, hidden-message retention, and reactivation scenario.

stop_conditions: Stop if branch retention would require a new product decision.
